lipid_panel.full_form_description: Measures the total amount of cholesterol in blood (includes HDL, LDL, and VLDL)
lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Indicates the overall cholesterol level; high levels increase heart disease risk
lipid_panel.high_value_indicates: Atherosclerosis, heart disease, poor diet, genetics, hypothyroidism

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Increased risk of heart attack, stroke, clogged arteries
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Hormone issues, depression, fatigue, nutrient malabsorption

lipid_panel.full_form_description: Low-Density Lipoprotein; "bad cholesterol" that builds up in arteries
lipid_panel.normal_range: Optimal: Less than 100 mg/dL; Near-optimal: 100–129 mg/dL
lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Transports cholesterol to tissues; excess leads to plaque in arteries

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Plaque buildup, increased heart disease/stroke risk
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: May reduce heart disease risk but very low levels may impair hormone synthesis

lipid_panel.full_form_description: High-Density Lipoprotein; "good cholesterol" that removes excess cholesterol
lipid_panel.normal_range: Men: 40 mg/dL or higher; Women: 50 mg/dL or higher; Ideal: 60 mg/dL or more
lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Cleans blood vessels by carrying cholesterol to liver for removal
lipid_panel.low_value_indicates: Higher risk of heart disease, metabolic syndrome

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Usually protective against heart disease
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: High cardiovascular risk, insulin resistance, obesity, metabolic issues

lipid_panel.full_form_description: Fat molecules in blood; stored energy
lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Reflects fat storage from calories not used; linked to metabolic health
lipid_panel.high_value_indicates: Obesity, type 2 diabetes, alcohol use, poor diet, thyroid disorders

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Pancreatitis, fatty liver, heart disease risk
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Malabsorption, poor diet, hyperthyroidism, wasting conditions

lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Transports triglycerides; contributes to cholesterol buildup in arteries
lipid_panel.high_value_indicates: Liver disease, diabetes, high carb intake

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Risk of fatty liver, heart disease
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Rarely significant but may reflect poor nutritional state

lipid_panel.full_form_description: Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase / Alanine Aminotransferase Liver enzyme; rises when liver is inflamed or damaged
lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Liver injury, fatty liver, hepatitis, alcohol

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Fatigue, nausea, pain in right side, jaundice

lipid_panel.full_form_description: Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase / Aspartate Aminotransferase
lipid_panel.high_value_indicates: Liver disease, heart attack, muscle damage

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Muscle/joint pain, liver pain, fatigue
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Not usually a concern unless both AST and ALT are low

lipid_panel.full_form_description: Visual grading of fat accumulation in liver tissue
lipid_panel.what_it_indicates: Detects non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) or alcoholic fatty liver
lipid_panel.high_value_indicates: Obesity, insulin resistance, high triglycerides, poor diet

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.grade_3: Risk of inflammation, scarring, NASH (non-alcoholic steatohepatitis)

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone – secreted by the pituitary to stimulate the thyroid
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Main screening test; controls thyroid hormone production

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Weight gain, cold intolerance, hair loss, fatigue, depression
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Anxiety, weight loss, sweating, fast heartbeat

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: Free Thyroxine – main inactive thyroid hormone circulating in blood
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Reflects hormone produced by thyroid gland

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Nervousness, palpitations, insomnia

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: Free Triiodothyronine – active form of thyroid hormone
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Active hormone influencing metabolism and mood
thyroid_panel.low_value_indicates: Hypothyroidism, poor conversion of T4 to T3

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Irritability, weight loss, tremors, anxiety
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Brain fog, low energy, weight gain, depression

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: Total Thyroxine – bound + unbound hormone in blood
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Measures overall T4 levels; less specific than free T4
thyroid_panel.high_value_indicates: High T4 production or high binding proteins

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Hyperthyroid symptoms
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Same as low Free T4 symptoms

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: Total Triiodothyronine – bound + free form of T3
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Overall T3 level in the blood

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Same as Free T3 – used in cross-check with Free T3

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: Inactive form of T3; blocks Free T3 action
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Indicates stress response or thyroid hormone resistance
thyroid_panel.low_value_indicates: Rarely tested for low; not usually significant

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Fatigue, sluggish metabolism, poor T3 effect

thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Detects autoimmune thyroid disease like Hashimoto’s or Graves’

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Autoimmune symptoms, thyroid gland attack, mood swings

thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Indicates autoimmune reaction against thyroid proteins

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Indicates thyroid inflammation, infertility risk, hair loss

thyroid_panel.full_form_description: TSH receptor antibody / Thyroid Stimulating Immunoglobulin
thyroid_panel.what_it_indicates: Confirms Graves' disease (overactive thyroid due to antibodies)

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Rapid weight loss, bulging eyes, anxiety, heat intolerance
Frequent urination, thirst, fatigue

complete_sugar_panel.what_it_indicates: Body’s ability to process sugar after eating

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Tiredness, blurry vision, hunger after eating

complete_sugar_panel.full_form_description: Glucose at any time, no fasting
complete_sugar_panel.what_it_indicates: Quick check for abnormal glucose at any time

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Diabetes symptoms

complete_sugar_panel.full_form_description: Avg. blood sugar over past 2–3 months
complete_sugar_panel.what_it_indicates: Best test to monitor long-term glucose control
complete_sugar_panel.low_value_indicates: May occur in anemia or chronic illness

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Long-term complications risk (eyes, kidneys, nerves)
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Rare – check for anemia or liver issues

complete_sugar_panel.full_form_description: Fasting + 1-hour and 2-hour blood sugar after 75g glucose

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Gestational diabetes, insulin resistance

complete_sugar_panel.full_form_description: Avg. blood sugar over 2–3 weeks (shorter than HbA1c)
complete_sugar_panel.what_it_indicates: Used in anemia, pregnancy, or rapid changes

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: Poor sugar control in last 2–3 weeks Useful when HbA1c is unreliable
Fatigue after eating, weight gain
symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.low: Sugar rises quickly, risk of ketoacidosis

complete_sugar_panel.full_form_description: Byproduct of insulin production – used to measure natural insulin output
complete_sugar_panel.what_it_indicates: Helps differentiate Type 1 vs Type 2 diabetes

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: PCOS, insulinoma

complete_sugar_panel.full_form_description: Homeostatic Model Assessment – uses insulin and glucose to estimate insulin resistance
complete_sugar_panel.high_value_indicates: High insulin resistance = early diabetes/metabolic syndrome

symptoms_risks_of_imbalance.high: PCOS, obesity, risk of diabetes Used in early lifestyle screening

thyroid_recipes.ingredients: - 1 ripe banana (sliced)- ½ cup Greek yogurt (plain, low-fat)- 1 tsp chia seeds- 1 tsp flaxseeds (ground)- Cinnamon (a pinch)

thyroid_recipes.ingredients: - ½ ripe avocado (diced)- 1 small cucumber (chopped)- A few spinach leaves or arugula- Lemon juice, olive oil, black pepper- Optional: pinch of roasted sunflower or pumpkin seeds

sugar_recipes.ingredients: - ½ cup canned chickpeas (rinsed & drained)- ¼ cup plain unsweetened Greek yogurt- ½ tsp cumin powder- A pinch of black salt or sea salt- Fresh parsley or cilantro (optional)
sugar_recipes.quick_method: 1. Mix chickpeas and yogurt in a bowl 2. Add cumin, salt, and herbs 3. Stir and serve chilled or at room temp
sugar_recipes.why_it_is_good: - High in protein & fiber- No added sugar- Chickpeas have a low glycemic index and promote fullness

sugar_recipes.ingredients: - ½ cup shredded green cabbage- ¼ cup grated carrot- 1 tbsp roasted pumpkin seeds (unsalted)- 1 tsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice- 1 tsp olive oil, pepper, salt
sugar_recipes.quick_method: 1. In a bowl, mix cabbage and carrot 2. Add pumpkin seeds 3. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar or lemon juice 4. Add salt and pepper to taste
sugar_recipes.why_it_is_good: - High fiber, low-carb, antioxidant-rich- Supports gut health and blood sugar control- No fruit, no sugar, no insulin spike
